options.feasibility: Available with existing project tools; no virtualization or original program execution.
options.scope: One pass of the fixed-hash EXE .text section (2963456 bytes) for FF15, FF25 and REX.W MOV RIP-relative operands resolving exactly to 0x1402d7318. At most 16 candidates; only then bounded .pdata lookup and actual instruction/function-boundary verification.
options.not_duplicate: Previously inspected same-algorithm results target 0x1402d78a0 and 0x1402d5510. No corresponding SetUI byte-candidate result was found in the reviewed records.
options.limits: Byte hits and .pdata coverage are candidates, not decoded calls. Zero hits does not exclude other encodings, register-indirect dispatch or runtime resolution. Do not expand to adjacent IAT slots, .bind processing or whole-client disassembly.
options.next: Prepare the narrow parameterization from existing code, review scope and test only changed candidate handling, then formal execution approval with original gates. Rea only for a supported actual candidate. No step executed in this assessment.

options.feasibility: Copying files does not isolate execution. Not acceptable by itself under current save/Steam-data boundary.
options.limits: Known Folder lookup may still return the logged-in user's profile; copied binaries can still use shared Steam services, registry and cloud APIs. Environment variables, an empty working directory, offline mode or a process Job alone do not establish confinement.
options.approval: Original startup remains prohibited. Do not create a runnable copy or launch merely to discover its writes. No verified native save-directory override was established; third-party editor savedir commands are not game launch switches.

options.option: Separate local standard user plus independently writable copy
options.feasibility: Conditional host-native option without CPU virtualization. A separate profile can separate per-user paths, but is not a complete sandbox.
options.limits: Existing shared-folder ACLs, machine-wide services, network and Steam IPC remain relevant. A new Windows user does not establish isolation of the same Steam account's cloud state. Actual license/startup dependencies and storage requirements are unknown.
options.approval: A dedicated nonadministrator account/profile, any folder/ACL or network-rule changes, debugger acquisition if needed, and one precise original startup/debug session require explicit prior approval. No changes to existing user's permissions or Steam configuration are proposed automatically.
options.precondition: First validate the prospective account/session and access design using self-owned harmless probes and synthetic files, not real saves. If original startup needs existing Steam data or authentication outside the approved test scope, stop; no DRM workaround.

options.option: Restricted token or AppContainer-based host launcher
options.feasibility: Windows access-control mechanisms do not require a guest OS. A restricted derivative of the caller's own token may avoid an assignment privilege requirement, but local launch rights and game compatibility are not verified.
options.limits: Merely removing privileges or using a write-only restricted token does not prove no reads of real saves. A restricted token retains the same user identity; Known Folders are not automatically redirected. File/registry/network/desktop/handle-inheritance boundaries all need explicit design. AppContainer is still process isolation, not an already available ready-made game sandbox.
options.approval: Any new launcher execution, application profile/capability grants or ACL setup must be reviewed before use. Start with only synthetic probes if approved. Do not modify real save ACLs or global security policy; no bypass flags, admin launch or network capability expansion to force success.

options.feasibility: Does not inherently require a VM or BIOS change. It is an observation mechanism to combine with a proven host access boundary, not isolation itself.
options.limits: Live memory access still requires appropriate process rights. Noninvasive debugging can suspend threads/read state but cannot perform normal execution-control commands, so it cannot alone capture future SetUI/LoadTableFile call events. Starting a target from an elevated debugger could elevate the target; this is excluded. Breakpoints also perturb timing and can alter process memory/register state.
options.minimum_capture_if_separately_approved: Same-identity nonadministrator target only: fixed module hashes/ASLR bases, SetUI RCX/RDX and return address, UI object's vptr, LoadTableFile string argument and caller. Prefer bounded hardware execution breakpoints where supported; no DLL injection, patching executable files, full dumps or unrelated memory capture.
options.approval: Exact debugger/source/version if missing and original copied-game execution/attachment require prior approval. No debugger or target was launched in this assessment.

recommendation.now: Finish the single bounded static alternative before asking the user to change BIOS or create an execution environment.
recommendation.if_static_still_empty: Offer one concrete host-native test-account/debugger plan only after specifying startup licensing, access/network boundary and test-only writable paths. Lack of current proof is not proof that a VM is mandatory.
recommendation.when_virtualization_might_help: If host-native confinement cannot both preserve the strict no-real-save/no-Steam-data boundary and support legal startup/graphics, a separate physical test system or VM may be preferable. Virtualization still does not automatically solve licensing/GPU compatibility; no BIOS or reboot request is warranted now.

official_sources.supports: Known Folder paths are associated with the user token; copying the executable does not select a new user profile.
Steam Client and Auto-Cloud/API storage synchronize game files; independent executable location alone does not isolate cloud state.
Restricted-token access checks and limited privilege exemption; separate desktop warning.
AppContainer controls file/registry/network/process resources; compatibility is a separate unverified issue.
Jobs group/account/limit processes; process security restrictions are separate.
Noninvasive observation suspends threads and does not offer normal execution control.
User-mode attach/spawn; spawned targets inherit debugger permissions and may use debug heap.
Process inspection requires the corresponding access rights; do not assume all-access or elevate after denial.
